the first images that come to mind are of war, poverty, famine and flies.

earth?"

--Henry Louis Gates, Jr.
,

"It is to correct these [Western]
misrepresentations and restore the true value and place of Negro culture and achievement
in the sum total of human progress that makes the study of African history today a double
necessity for both Africans and non-Africans."

K.B.C. Onwubiko
 
from "The Importance of African History
Today,"

History of West Africa, A D 1000-1800
 (1967. Nigeria: Africana-FEP Publishers
